# sq-62 — Internal issue-code registry and evidence-stage constants

The schema test that ties the closed enums to the code reads issue codes from the library IL (a string literal within 48 instructions before `newobj Issue::.ctor` or `LocatedIssue`) and evidence stages from the private `Profiler.StageOrder`. A code built from a variable or a `static readonly` field, or a stage missing from `StageOrder` (an unknown stage sorts last, not rejected), is missed unless a golden produces it. Name the codes as internal constants with an `All` list, scan stage literals, and compare the schema to those lists with the IL scan only as a subset check. No descriptor byte change. Should land before sq-09 and sq-10, which add about 8 codes.
